title: Null-Validated Topological Signatures of Financial Market Dynamics
summary: Financial markets exhibit temporal organization that is not fully captured by volatility measures or linear correlation structure. We study a null-validated topological approach for quantifying financial market complexity using Bitcoin daily log returns and the S&P 500 index as examples of cryptocurrency and broad U.S. equity market dynamics. The analysis uses the $L^1$ norm of the persistence landscapes computed from sliding-window delay embeddings. This quantity co-moves strongly with stochastic volatility during periods of market stress, but the strength and form of this relationship vary…
